_comment: Every demo on the launcher comes from this file.
The random suffix is what makes the URL unguessable. Use something
3. Bump VERSION in /sw.js so iPads pick up the change.
type   'app'  — an interactive demo in demos/<slug>/
'link' — hosted elsewhere; set url instead of slug
slug   folder name under demos/   (app and deck)
title_bn  the title in Bangla; its first letter is drawn on the card
when there is no thumb (the card font has no Latin letters)
date   YYYY-MM-DD — the list sorts newest first

demos.title: Room configurator
demos.notes: Two room types, switchable furniture and roof layers. 3D — drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. Large models: open it once on wifi before the meeting.

demos.title: Calligraphy frame
demos.notes: 3D model — drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. 9 MB and 125k triangles: open it once on wifi well before the meeting.

demos.title: Infographic installation
demos.notes: 3D model — drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. 2 MB, quick to open.

demos.title: Bed
demos.notes: 3D model — drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. 9 MB and 125k triangles: open it once on wifi well before the meeting.

demos.title: Six-hole flute designer
demos.notes: Enter a scale and the tube's inner and outer diameter; it sizes and places the holes, draws a 1:1 working drawing and a 3D model. Exports SVG, CSV and OpenSCAD.

demos.title: Tap metronome
demos.notes: Tap to set the tempo; shows BPM and the beat length in milliseconds, plus the ms for every note value. Press Start for an audible click.

demos.title: Coffee counter
demos.notes: Textured 3D model in SketchUp style, edges on. Drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. 7 MB: open it once on wifi before the meeting.

demos.title: School
demos.notes: Textured 3D model in SketchUp style: the full building and its floors laid out side by side. Drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. 3 MB, quick to open.

demos.title: Residence Interior Design
demos.notes: Textured 3D model in SketchUp style, edges on. Drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. 57 MB: open it once on wifi before the meeting.
